question: After Jesus stayed two days in their town, what did many Samaritans tell the woman?
options: We will follow him to Jerusalem
We believe because of your words alone
We have heard for ourselves, and we know this man really is the Savior of the world
explanation: John 4:42 says they told her they no longer believed just because of what she said, for they had heard for themselves and knew he really was the Savior of the world.
